description: This Java class 'CameraPreview' manages camera preview display in an Android application, handling surface lifecycle events, camera orientation calculations, and starting/stopping the camera preview.

classes.name: CameraPreview
classes.description: A SurfaceView subclass that displays a camera preview and manages its lifecycle, including orientation adjustments.

methods.name: CameraPreview
methods.description: Constructor initializing the camera preview with context, camera, camera info, and display orientation.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Sets the camera preview display when the surface is created.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup when surface is destroyed.

methods.name: surfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the surface, restarting the camera preview with correct orientation.

methods.name: calculatePreviewOrientation
methods.description: Calculates the correct display orientation for the camera preview based on device rotation and camera info.
